text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The entrance is the gateway through
which all
types of qi passes! Keep it
spotless to prevent any
unwelcome
energy from coming into your home!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, next, maybe I should focus on
boosting
luck for a successful career?
For an Umamusume,
that means winning
races!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll clean all the light
fixtures, and it'll
raise everyone's
chances of success!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I've worked up a good sweat. It
takes so
much stamina to clean the
higher up areas.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Are you... the Dragon God?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm flying on the Dragon God's back!
This is
incredible! I can see the whole
town from up here!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? This qi current... could there be
dragon
holes over there too?! I had no
idea!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! I can see the veins of qi so
clearly!
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...More! More! Give me the earth's
power!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where am I? Oh... that's right... I
took a
break after cleaning. And then... I
must have
fallen asleep and had a
dream?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but that dream was definitely a
message
from the Dragon God.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If the spot it showed me really contains a
dragon
hole, then I'll be able to use the
earth's power to
further improve my
running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Copano Rickey gains some feng

shui-inspired insight, and her track
performance
becomes even sharper from
that day onward.
